title: github-settings
description: Schema for .github-settings.yaml repo settings specs. REQUIRED org norms (KB-82) are pinned as const — a spec declaring any other value is invalid by construction, deterministically, independent of any LLM reading the file. Keep the const values in sync with the norm comments in templates/github-settings.yaml. The squash norms are required only where squash merging is actually reachable (KB-117); branch_protection is open so a repo may declare stricter protection than the norm.

squash_title.$comment: REQUIRED org norm (KB-82): any other value drops [TICKET-ID] from single-commit squashes

squash_message.$comment: REQUIRED org norm (KB-82): any other value drops provenance trailers from squash bodies

allOf.$comment: KB-117: require the squash norms unless allowed_methods is present AND excludes squash. Absence is treated as reachable — GitHub enables all three methods by default, so an undeclared allowed_methods means squash is on and the footgun applies.

then.$comment: squash unreachable — the squash norms are meaningless here

branch_protection.$comment: KB-117: open by design. A repo declaring MORE protection than the norm (approval counts, required check contexts, admin enforcement) is safer, not non-compliant — rejecting it is the same bug class as a lint pattern rejecting a correctly formatted title. Cost accepted: a typo'd key is not caught here.
